Summary:  
This test function verifies the behavior of the HTTP cache when handling an incomplete resource request that is subsequently canceled.

Parameters:  
None

Returns:  
None

Logic:  
The function sets up a mock HTTP cache and transaction, simulating a GET request with incomplete resource data. It creates a truncated cache entry and initiates a regular request while queuing another request to the same transaction. The test checks that the transaction starts correctly and that data can be read from the cache. After canceling the requests, it verifies the state of the cache, ensuring that the expected number of transactions and cache operations occurred. Finally, it cleans up by removing the mock transaction.
